propositions: Comment identity must be determined by persistent HLC-timestamp-keyed map to Jira comment ID, not body-text equality, to prevent collisions from identical bodies and treat edits as new comments.

The returned Jira comment ID from add_comment must be captured at both create_one and update_one enactment sites and persisted immediately via write-ahead record_comment_id save() for crash durability.

Outbound comment skip logic must be gated primarily by the HLC key being mapped or jira_comment_id being present, demoting body-equality to secondary fallback, while inbound-origin jira_comment_id remains authoritative only for its direction.
Comment bodies must render through RichTextCodec.to_wire (AdfCodec for Cloud, WikiTextCodec for DC), with text fitting applied before JSON serialization to prevent truncation of wire format.
The _diff_comments dedup-key path must migrate from _IdentityCodec to the real codec injected via OutboundMapper.comment_codec to achieve convergence after codec normalization changes in story 3388.
